interface.signature: def canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t must be equal.
The number of moves k must be between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s must contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (all((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i]) + 26) % 26 <= k - 26 * (ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i]) + 26) % 26 // 26 for i in range(len(s))))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if it is possible to convert s into t in no more than k moves, otherwise false.
